meaning.en: just now it was seen by me

meaning.en: what else is there, what could stand out

meaning.en: in the great ocean of brahman's bliss
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मानंद के महासागर में

meaning.en: filled with unbroken nectar

meaning.en: I do not see, I do not hear

meaning.en: I exist through my own self alone
meaning.hi: मैं केवल अपनी ही आत्मा से हूँ

meaning.en: in the form of eternal bliss — that alone is my mark
meaning.hi: नित्य-आनंद के रूप में — वही मेरा लक्षण है

meaning.hi: मैं असंग हूँ, मैं शरीर-रहित हूँ

meaning.en: I am without a mark, I am Hari
meaning.hi: मैं चिह्न-रहित हूँ, मैं हरि हूँ

meaning.en: I am peaceful, entirely, through and through
meaning.hi: मैं शांत हूँ, पूरी तरह, आर-पार

meaning.en: I am endless, full, ancient/existing since old

meaning.en: nothing in me transforms, nothing in me decays
meaning.hi: मुझमें बदलाव नहीं, क्षय नहीं

meaning.en: my own form is awareness, and I am pure

meaning.en: I am alone, I am Shiva, always at peace
